newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures firmer, helped by dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures firmer, helped by dollar.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures closed firmer on Friday, helped by the dollar's strength against the yen, traders said.

"The firmer dollar helped," said one trader at one of Japan's leading trading houses. "Individual investors are currently focusing on gold which recently saw 12 year lows. The upside for aluminium on the LME looks heavy."
The benchmark June contract added 0.1 yen to end at 185.9 yen, while the April gained 1.0 yen to 187.1 yen. Others ranged from between 0.7 and 3.1 yen firmer.
The dollar was trading just below 114 yen, while yen-based Tokyo precious metals futures finished with solid gains, partly on bargain-hunting.
In London overnight, three-month aluminium finished up $2 at $1,570, unable to wade through the resistance above $1,580.
